text.p: Sizzler International Inc., which is in the midst of a financial reorganization after filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, said Wednesday that Timothy Ryan resigned as president of Sizzler USA.
Kevin Perkins, Sizzler International president and chief executive officer, will head Sizzler's domestic business, the company said.

"In developing our plan to reorganize our business and emerge from Chapter 11 protection, it became clear that we had to change Sizzler USA's organisational structure to meet current realities," said Perkins.

Sizzler, which filed for protection against its creditors on June 2, said it expects to offer a reorganization plan before year-end. It also expects to emerge from Chapter 11 by April 30, 1997, the end of its current fiscal year.
